content.short: Infini is a stablecoin-powered financial platform with corporate cards, payouts and multi-region payments.
content.description: Infini is a financial platform for borderless businesses and individuals built on stablecoins. Companies can make multi-region payments, issue corporate cards, run payouts and manage expenses, with an AI assistant for accounting. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Infini.
content.meta: Infini is a stablecoin financial platform with corporate cards and global payments, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
